prereg_command_finding: sec1 names `python scripts/ember_restart/contract.py validate configs/ember-restart-3b.json` as the fail-closed prerequisite. Executed as written, that command returns 24 field errors: configs/ember-restart-3b.json is an ember-restart contract CONFIG (contract_name/contract_version/namespaces), not an ember-owned-rung-v1 rung manifest. The named path cannot validate green at any point in the ladder. Either sec1's path is wrong or the rung manifest it intends has yet to be authored; this is filed for adjudication, not patched here.

cert_gated_inputs.why: The subject checkpoint is held in private custody: manifests/ember-current-subject-v1.json records checkpoint_custody.class='private_checkpoint_bytes' with public_manifest_bytes_present=false. The contract resolves checkpoint.path relative to the manifest root and hashes the bytes, so it needs bytes this public tree does not hold.

The contract requires a registry whose schema_version equals 'ember-trusted-verifiers-v1'. The only candidate in the tree, manifests/ember-01-identity/trusted-verifiers-v1.json, carries no schema_version field at all and is rejected as 'invalid schema_version'. No conforming registry exists yet.
Both are receipt objects with path+sha256 bound to the certified run's artifacts. They are produced by EMBER-01 certification, not authored ahead of it.
